pd_seed.name: crypt
pd_seed.title: Ancient Crypt

room_descs.text: The air is cold and stale, carrying the faint scent of dust and old stone.
Broken sarcophagi and chipped bones litter the floor in quiet disarray.
Torchlight barely reaches the corners, where shadows cling to the walls.
A hush hangs over the chamber, broken only by the scrape of your own boots.
A chalky film coats the floor, and the seams between the stones have been picked at by patient hands.

hide_look_texts: One stone in the wall has been shifted just enough to reveal a shallow hollow behind it.
The sarcophagus lid has been pried aside, exposing a thin shelf of dust and bone chips.
hide_hint_phrases: The wall here feels colder than the rest, as though something hollow lies behind it.
A fine trail of grit cuts toward the rear wall and then vanishes.

pd_seed.name: cave
pd_seed.title: Dark Cave

room_descs.text: The cavern breathes cold moisture from the stone, leaving a slick shine across the floor.
Faint water drips somewhere in the dark, marking a slow and patient rhythm.
Jagged rock walls close in around the path, rough and untamed.
The air tastes mineral and deep, as though the underground never fully sleeps.
Mineral growths glitter weakly in the dark, and every drip from the ceiling rings out like a bell.

hide_look_texts: A wet seam runs between two slabs of stone, and the crack widens into a hand-sized gap.
A crawlspace has been scraped into the wall here, just high enough to miss in a quick glance.
hide_hint_phrases: Water keeps tapping the same stone in a slow, deliberate rhythm.
The floor slopes toward a tight space where the dust has been disturbed.

pd_seed.name: ruins
pd_seed.title: Ancient Ruins

room_descs.text: Broken arches and fallen stone make the room feel half-remembered.
Weeds force their way through cracks in the floor, softening the ruin with green life.
The wind pushes through empty windows, carrying dust and the smell of rain.
Every wall bears the long ache of neglect, as if the place is waiting to be claimed again.
Weathered carvings still cling to the broken walls, half buried beneath root and leaf.

hide_look_texts: A collapsed arch leaves a wedge-shaped gap in the stone, just wide enough to hide a cache.
The lintel has sagged into the floor, and dust has collected in a narrow seam behind it.
hide_hint_phrases: The ivy parts around one section of wall as if it has been touched more often than the rest.
Broken stone here forms a pocket where the wind refuses to settle.

pd_seed.name: mountain
pd_seed.title: Frozen Mountain

room_descs.text: Thin air and biting wind make every breath feel sharp.
Ice crusts the stone in pale sheets, and the cold seems to press back against you.
Snow gathers in sheltered corners while the exposed ground is swept bare.
The mountain feels vast and severe, its silence broken only by the hiss of the wind.
Thin air burns the lungs, and the stone underfoot is glazed with old frost.

hide_look_texts: A thin crack in the ice has been brushed clear, leaving a shallow hollow behind it.
Snow has drifted against the wall in a shape that hides a narrow gap from casual sight.
hide_hint_phrases: The wind whistles through one seam in the stone as if the mountain itself were breathing.
A patch of frost refuses to melt, even where the rest of the room is warmer.

pd_seed.name: stronghold
pd_seed.title: Ancient Stronghold

room_descs.text: The chamber is built for discipline, with hard angles and little wasted space.
Old banners hang in dusty silence, their colors faded but still proud.
Iron fittings and worn stone suggest a fortress that has seen far more duty than rest.
The air carries the weight of old orders, strict and unyielding.
The walls are scored by drill marks and old impacts, as if the fortress had never known a quiet day.

hide_look_texts: One flagstone is stamped with a runic mark that does not match the others, and it shifts slightly underfoot.
The iron grate has been unlatched and tucked into the wall, hiding a narrow recess behind it.
hide_hint_phrases: The floor here rings a little duller than the rest of the hall.
A faint draft rises from beneath the ironwork, carrying dust and old oil.

pd_seed.name: castle
pd_seed.title: Haunted Castle

room_descs.text: The castle still clings to its old grandeur, even through dust and decay.
Creaking boards and faded tapestries make the hall feel haunted by former elegance.
A cold draft moves through the room, stirring the smell of old wood and wax.
The silence here has a formal, patient quality, like a lord waiting behind a closed door.
Dust hangs in the air like a veil, and the old tapestries still carry a faint smell of smoke and wax.

hide_look_texts: A carved panel sits slightly proud of the wall, and a quick shove would likely open it.
The tapestry hangs on a hook that has been nudged aside, revealing a strip of stone behind it.
hide_hint_phrases: The wall here gives off the stale scent of old wood instead of cold stone.
The fabric near this section has been handled more often than the rest.

pd_seed.name: forest
pd_seed.title: Mysterious Forest

room_descs.text: Green light filters through the branches, softening every edge in the room.
Moss and root weave across the ground, muffling your steps.
The trees stand close enough to feel like witnesses, patient and silent.
The forest breathes around you with wet leaves, bark, and a faint trace of rain.
Roots buckle the ground in slow ridges, and the light overhead turns a deep green.

hide_look_texts: A moss-covered stump hides a shallow pocket at its base, just large enough for a cache.
One root has split around a knot in the wood, leaving a dark seam behind it.
hide_hint_phrases: The moss here grows in a ring that looks too deliberate to be natural.
Birdsong falls silent where the roots part and the ground dips lower.

pd_seed.name: den
pd_seed.title: Beast's Lair

room_descs.text: The den reeks of old fur, stale blood, and the restless heat of beasts nearby.
Claw marks rake the walls, and the floor is scattered with bones and torn scraps.
The darkness feels alive here, pressed tight with the scent of predators.
Low sounds echo from deeper within, too soft to be voices and too sharp to be wind.
The air is warm and thick, carrying the copper tang of blood beneath the stink of old fur.

hide_look_texts: The stone here is scraped smooth by claws, and a shallow hide has been carved into the wall.
A rib bone has been wedged into a crack in the floor, hiding a thin seam beneath it.
hide_hint_phrases: A wet smell of fur and old blood lingers where the wall bends inward.
The floor is scored in a circle, as though something was dragged into the darkness.

pd_seed.name: marsh
pd_seed.title: Cursed Marsh

room_descs.text: Black water swallows the light, and the air tastes of mud and rot.
The swamp floor shifts underfoot, soft with mud and tangled roots.
Insects buzz in the thick air, circling the stagnant pools around you.
Half-submerged stonework hints at ruins trying to claw their way back to the surface.
Black water presses close to the walls, and every breath tastes of mud, rot, and stagnant weed.

hide_look_texts: A plinth coated in mud has been scraped clean on one side, exposing a narrow seam behind it.
One stone step breaks the waterline here, leaving a shallow pocket hidden under the sludge.
hide_hint_phrases: The mud around this wall has been disturbed more than the rest, as if something was recently moved.
A hollow knock sounds when the waterline laps against the stone.

pd_seed.name: island
pd_seed.title: Lost Island

room_descs.text: Salt air and wet sand cling to the room, carrying the distant sound of surf.
Broken stone and jungle roots share the space, as if the island is reclaiming every wall.
The heat is heavy and close, but the ocean wind never quite leaves the room.
A weather-worn ruin stands here, half hidden beneath vines and sea spray.
Salt spray dries in white crusts on the stone, while palm fronds whisper somewhere beyond the walls.

hide_look_texts: A slab of barnacled stone has been loosened by the tide, exposing a pocket behind it.
Sand has drifted into a low shelf in the wall, hiding the edge of a concealed niche.
hide_hint_phrases: The surf seems louder near this wall, as if it echoes through a hollow behind it.
Palm shadows gather here in a shape that does not match the rest of the room.

pd_seed.name: plains
pd_seed.title: Desolate Plains

room_descs.text: The land feels open and exposed, with the wind carrying dust across the ground.
Long grass bends low in the gusts, whispering against scattered stones.
The emptiness here is wide and deliberate, broken only by a few battered remains.
Ash and dry earth cling to the room, giving it the color of old loss.
The open country feels exposed even inside the room, and the air smells of dry grass and ash.

hide_look_texts: A cindered post leans out of the earth, and something has been tucked behind its base.
The grass here has been pressed flat in a neat line leading to a narrow seam in the dirt.
hide_hint_phrases: The wind dies away in a shallow dip that seems deeper than it should be.
A strip of blackened earth cuts across the room like a path no one remembers making.

pd_seed.name: skyreach
pd_seed.title: Skyreach Tower

room_descs.text: The room hangs high above the world, where the wind feels thin and sharp.
Clouds drift below the floor, making the chamber feel strangely weightless.
The stone is pale and cold, with every edge sharpened by altitude and light.
A distant horizon presses at the edges of sight, vast and unreachable.
The floor seems to hover over the world below, and the wind tugs at loose cloth and hair alike.

hide_look_texts: A frosted brace in the wall has been loosened, leaving a slit of cold air behind it.
The ceiling opens to a narrow slice of sky where a cache could easily be concealed.
hide_hint_phrases: The wind sounds different here, as if it passes through a narrow chamber behind the wall.
Cloud-shadow gathers in a place where no cloud should be.

pd_seed.name: temple
pd_seed.title: Sunken Temple

room_descs.text: Incense and damp stone mingle in the air, giving the room a solemn hush.
Carved idols stare from the walls, worn smooth by age and devotion.
The floor is marked with old ritual lines, their purpose long since forgotten.
Even in ruin, the chamber feels arranged for ceremony rather than rest.
Incense clings to the damp stone, mingling with the smell of river water and old offerings.

hide_look_texts: A carved idol has been nudged forward just enough to expose a narrow hollow behind it.
The altar stones are slick with moisture, and one seam has been pried open by hand.
hide_hint_phrases: The incense smell is strongest near one section of wall where the dust looks newly disturbed.
Water collects in a thin line at the base of the altar, as if something has shifted there recently.

pd_seed.name: dungeon_depths
pd_seed.title: Dungeon Depths

room_descs.text: The dungeon is cold and close, with iron and stone pressing in from every side.
Old chains hang from the walls, their links dull from years of use.
The floor is stained and uneven, and the silence feels punished into place.
A sour, metallic smell lingers here, as if the room remembers too much.
Iron rings rattle softly against the walls, and the stale air smells of rust, sweat, and old punishment.

hide_look_texts: A scratched post beside the wall has been loosened from its bracket, leaving room for a cache behind it.
The grate in the floor is sealed with a thin layer of rust that hides a concealed latch.
hide_hint_phrases: The chain noise is louder here, though nothing is moving behind the bars.
A draft rises from the pit, carrying the smell of old iron and wet stone.
